description:
In this video I want to share with you my philosophy on how to become more confident.

PREORDER MY NEW BOOK: https://vinhgiang.com/before-we-forget-how-to-connect
FREE Frameworks Training ➡ https://free.vinhgiang.com/htac-frameworks
I'll teach you 3 communication frameworks to master conversations 🗣️

If you want to be a more confident person, you need to start practicing confident behaviors. The reason why you're so good at being shy is because you've been practicing SHY behaviors for decades!

So the first step to improving your confidence is to realise that YOU, are not shy, you've just been practicing shy behaviors for so long that you identify as shy now. So in this video I'll help you identify exactly what are the shy behaviors and the confident behaviors so you can start to make a shift in the way you communicate and come across to others!

=== About Vinh Giang ===
Vinh Giang is an internationally acclaimed keynote speaker, communication skills expert, and magician. He blends his unique talents to captivate audiences and deliver powerful lessons on the art of influence, persuasion, and effective communication. His mission is to empower individuals and leaders to communicate with clarity, confidence, and impact, enabling them to unlock new levels of success in both their personal and professional lives.
